reviewScope.summary: Technical review of a two-file CI-only Playwright three-worker benchmark. Existing local single-worker behavior, full certification, strict failure policy, browser coverage, retry policy and production protection are preserved.
evidence: Source baseline: 8815bdc1fc3cf932ac921a610cf70a76d24f89aa; 290 E2E tests in 48.0 minutes with one worker in PR #50.
Reviewed Playwright default configuration and managed configuration inheritance; GitHub Actions CI=true selects 3 workers, local runs select 1.
Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript and targeted release architecture test executed on the isolated source candidate before evidence commit.
Adversarial assessment: simultaneous Chromium processes share the 4-vCPU/16-GB GitHub runner; browser contexts are isolated but external file/network resources might not be.
Full 290-test three-worker GitHub result has not occurred at review time; merge is contingent on ordinary authoritative Final candidate success.
PR #51 run 40944340044: three workers verified; 76 passed, one substantive test failure, two interrupted and 211 not run (fail-fast).
Attached trace identified one net::ERR_ABORTED GET for character-profile.png, followed by successful HTTP 200 for the identical URL. No HTTP error on the asset.

Changed exactly one E2E probe to require a later successful response before treating a cancelled GET as benign. Non-abort request failures, HTTP errors, console errors and unresolved cancellations remain blocking.
The corrected full three-worker suite has not yet been executed; a fresh GitHub Final candidate pass is required before merge.

adversarialFindings.description: Three concurrent browser workers can reveal shared-resource races or create CPU/memory contention.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted for a draft-PR benchmark only. Existing no-retry, max-one-failure and full-gate safeguards remain. Do not merge a failing or incomplete run.

adversarialFindings.description: Changing the original worker configuration would also increase local Windows browser processes.
adversarialFindings.resolution: CI-conditioned workers keeps local execution at the existing one-worker setting.

adversarialFindings.description: The release architecture test pins the previous workers: 1 configuration.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The same source commit updates the architecture assertion to pin three workers in CI and one locally.

adversarialFindings.description: This release-control configuration change makes the immediate Task A shadow merge ineligible for reuse.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Expected full-only transition; do not change or weaken Task A provenance rules.

adversarialFindings.description: The Epic E capture probe reported a navigation-cancelled asset GET as a permanent failure although the same asset later returned HTTP 200.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Track cancelled GETs and require a subsequent HTTP success for the identical URL. Preserve failure for non-abort network errors and unresolved cancellations.

retrospective.summary: PASS for a draft-PR empirical evaluation of three workers. Do not claim proven speedup or production readiness until all 290 hosted E2E tests, native Final candidate and actual run-time comparison pass. First three-worker CI attempt exposed a false-positive cancellation assertion. Surgical remediation was technically reviewed against the supplied trace; authoritative complete GitHub certification is still required.
